📺 Murder in Marketing (2026)

Murder in Marketing follows the employees of Not Bad, a non-alcoholic sparkling wine company, whose already chaotic workplace becomes the center of a shocking murder mystery. During an important marketing launch, the team discovers that their CEO has been killed, turning an ordinary corporate crisis into a hilarious investigation where everyone becomes a suspect. As coworkers attempt to uncover the truth, hidden agendas, professional rivalries, suspicious behavior, and bizarre clues create even more confusion. With each employee hiding something and workplace tensions reaching new heights, the team must use their marketing skills to solve a mystery that could destroy the company. Starring Tony Cavalero, Zainab Johnson, Kirk Fox, Flula Borg, and Patrick Ren
